whatsNew.summary: Choose the live preview and HQ transcription models, and install Parakeet, from Settings. Includes everything in 0.5.288. Requires server 6.72.0.

sections.title: Transcription models
items: Settings has a Transcription card. Pick the Preview model for live chunks and the HQ model for saved meetings. The choices come from your server.
Preview changes apply to the next live chunk and HQ changes to the next saved meeting. Nothing switches in the middle of a meeting.
On a server older than 6.72.0 the card is not shown.

sections.title: Parakeet install
items: When Parakeet is not installed, Install Parakeet downloads it and the card shows its progress until it is installed.
Install is not offered while a recording is live. If the install fails, the card shows the reason and offers the button again.

sections.title: Included from 0.5.288
items: Set a Home city in the Meeting assistant card so fact checks start from the right place.
A meeting the server already finished no longer shows as Live now with hours of No audio.
